sentences.en: It opens with an outline map and the superimposition of the rather rigid zones used by the emergency planners.

sentences.en: The deposit was produced by superimposition of the hot-water sedimentary mineralization and magmatic hydatogenesis.

sentences.en: In the later period, it underwent repeatedly tectonic superimposition of extrusion and extension,(http://sentencedict.com/superimposition.html) leading to the formation of the today's landscape.

sentences.en: With MCU AT89C52, superimposition chip of MB90092 and pseudorandom characters superimposed, the action such as taking down the camera may be sensed by the system.

sentences.en: The controlling effect of the superimposition of two type folded structural systems on gold deposit provides guiding significance for determining ore prospect orientation.
sentences.vi: Tác động kiểm soát của sự chồng chất của hai hệ thống cấu trúc xếp nếp lên mỏ vàng cung cấp ý nghĩa định hướng cho việc xác định định hướng triển vọng quặng.

sentences.en: Owing to the influence of tectonic superimposition and reworking at the late stage, both show fault or hidden unconformable contact relationships at present.
